name: Re-orientation Trigger Condition

trigger_logic.formula: Trigger_Reorient(x,c,R_↔,C_t,C_t^S) = TRUE iff [δ_a(x;c)=∅] OR [C_t^S=∅] OR [S_closure < τ_R] OR [Def_a(x,c) requires new -(i)]

branches.false_case: If FALSE, ordinary Arb_A realization proceeds over C_t^S.
branches.success_branch: If TRUE and NavT produces admissible -(i)', re-enter δ_a under -(i)'.
branches.failure_branch: If TRUE and no admissible orientation exists, enter 0-state collapse review.

pipeline_position: after δ_a/S failure or closure-support degradation, before ordinary Arb_A realization
